title: Shopping list grouped by aisle
when: The user wants a grocery or shopping list to use in the store: quick add, grouped by aisle, tick items as bought.
prompt:
Goal: A list that is fast to fill at home and fast to use one handed in the store.
Steps:
1. Item { id, name, qty, aisle, bought }; one input understands "2 milk" through parseItem in logic.mjs.
2. Assign an aisle from a keyword map (milk to Dairy, apple to Produce) the user can override; remember overrides per name.
3. Group by aisle in store order with headings; bought items move to a collapsed Bought section and can be unticked.
4. Checkbox with label per item, rows at least 48 px tall; Clear bought button.
5. Frequent items from history as quick add buttons; adding an existing item merges quantities.
6. Persist in localStorage shopping.v1 guarded; share as text with navigator.share when present, else copy to clipboard.
7. test.mjs: parseItem, aisle lookup with override, grouping order, merge 2 milk plus 1 milk.
Quality bar:
- Adding takes one field and Enter.
- Bought items stay visible but out of the way.
- Large text and contrast for store lighting.
Pitfalls:
- Duplicate rows for the same item.
- Swipe only interactions.
- Losing the list when the phone sleeps.
Verify:
- [ ] Checkboxes labeled.
- [ ] Form has a submit button.
- [ ] Data reloads.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (parse, group, merge), test.mjs.

examples.input: lista de compras do mercado separada por corredor
examples.output: "2 leite" goes to Dairy, Produce/Bakery groups, Bought section
